clips.about: Each kit thing that moves: its clips as its kind wrote them (what it is and how a player meets it, whether it plays at the start, whether it loops, its seconds). A clip of tracks is the glb's animation named in its `animation`, moving the bones of the kit mesh's skin. A clip of poses moves the parts it names: each pose a time and its morph target on the glb's kit mesh, null where the pose is the thing as it stands, each corner going in a straight line between two poses. Each joint is a bone a game may pose with no clip: `joint` its node among the skin's joints, `axis` in that node's own space, `range` the degrees from rest it may turn, and `couple` (where it has one) the joint whose turn drives it, `ratio` times over, as the thing's own linkage does.

fire.about: The top round stripped forward out of the lips and up into the chamber by the bolt running home; the next one up takes its place.
fire.how: Each shot that leaves a round to feed.

reload.about: Let go by the release and fallen free of the well; a full one pushed up into the well and tugged to be sure the catch holds.

reload_empty.about: The empty one fallen free; a full one seated.

shot.about: Fired: the bullet gone down the bore, the case drawn back with the breech and thrown from the port tumbling, then the next round chambered in its place.
shot.how: Each shot: its gun plays fire on every piece.

shot_last.about: Fired, the last round: the bullet gone, the case thrown, nothing chambered after it.
shot_last.how: The shot that empties the gun.
